summary: 1. Notion Meeting Notes Database queried for meetings created on or after 2026-07-22 — one result, the same "Personal Life Management System Walkthrough" personal-Notion demo already flagged out of scope by the 76th pass. 2. No new meeting notes. 3. Key findings `FW_ KPIs Please share with your Teams.eml` (Important References) carries two items from General Manager Ivan Anthony, both requiring Peter to brief his team: the 2026 bonus rule (no pro-rata; continuous employment 1-Jan to 31-Dec-2026 required; pays March 2027) and the new JRAR Core KPI Framework — Role-Based Weighting Policy v2, effective 1-Mar-2026, EXCO/Board-approved. 4. Six weighted KPI categories (Company Performance, Safety & HSEQ, Production & Productivity, Cost Efficiency, Quality/Technical Compliance, Workforce & Training), each reweighted by role. 5. Production & Productivity carries a fleet-utilization floor of ≥85% — directly relevant to the standing EX-123/DT-108/DT-109/DR-343 long-term-down situations this KB has tracked since June. 6. First formal board-approved KPI policy in this KB's corpus. `Project Finances/P&L Ad Duwayhi 06-26.xlsx` (June 2026 Income Statement, no covering email this cycle) shows the site still losing money but by less than budgeted: June gross profit −0.864M SAR actual vs a budgeted −1.379M loss (37.4% better than plan) vs −4.644M in June 2025. 7. YTD gross profit −6.464M vs an −8.174M YTD budget (20.9% better than plan). 8. Only February posted a profitable month in the Jan-Jun trend. 9. Spareparts Consumption & Repair is the standout YTD overrun (+87.3% over budget) — the cost line most directly tied to the fleet's standing breakdown register (EX-123, DT-108, DT-109, DR-343, and the earlier DT-282/DT-346 final-drive issues). Diesel fuel is the standout saving (−19.4% under YTD budget). Not promoted to the Wiki — stays in Outputs, same treatment as the May 2026 P&L (16th pass). Workshop Daily Task 30-Jul-2026.pdf registered at index level only (image-only, consistent with every prior file of this type). Both new Important References items synthesised into `Outputs/important-references-analysis_2026-07-29.md`. Important References folder now 29 files. Queried the Task Feedback Log's "All Feedback" view (33 rows, sorted Date Logged descending) — every row already shows Status "Processed," most recent Date Logged 2026-07-23 (the six rows the 72nd pass resolved). Landed in the Tasks Database Inbox (Status = Inbox, Assignee = Peter, Life Area/Project/dates left empty for triage). ---
